custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the autographs; AI often generates gibberish or melting text here. Also, inspect the intersection of the red stitching and the white leather for any 'bleeding' or lack of depth, which would indicate a topology error. Verify that the shadow cast by the ball onto the acrylic stand is physically consistent with the light source.
